title: Congo (Spanish Edition)
description: Una expedición entra en la selva del Congo para investigar la muerte de unos exploradores y localizar diamantes de gran valor industrial. Una gorila capaz de comunicarse mediante signos acompaña al grupo en un viaje donde tecnología, ambición y peligros desconocidos chocan.

ca.title: Congo (Spanish Edition)

en.description: An expedition enters the Congo rainforest to investigate a previous team's deaths and locate industrially valuable diamonds. Accompanied by a gorilla who communicates through signs, its members confront dangers that test both their technology and their commercial ambitions.
